architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events via SVC-102 (Event Bus). Within a capability, services may communicate freely. SVC-005 (CAP-002) and SVC-012 (CAP-004) are in different capabilities — EVT-032/EVT-033 is the only permitted communication channel between them. No synchronous API calls cross the CAP-002 / CAP-004 boundary.

services.role_in_journey: Primary owning service for JRN-007. Owns the end-to-end origination workflow within CAP-002: creates LoanApplication (ENT-017), FacilityAgreement (ENT-019), LoanAccount (ENT-020), and CovenantMonitoring (ENT-021). Business Lending (CAP-002.02) is a RETAINED sub-capability implemented entirely within SVC-005 — there is no separate business lending microservice.

consumed_events.name: CreditAssessmentCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-007 PH-018: Receives automated IRB scoring results (PD, LGD, EAD, ECL, risk_rating) from SVC-012. Stores assessment_id reference on LoanApplication. Routes to Credit Analyst (PER-056) queue. Triggers mandatory committee referral if risk_rating >= 8.

consumed_apis.call_pattern: Synchronous (within-capability payment instruction at PH-021 drawdown)
consumed_apis.purpose: SVC-005 instructs SVC-009 to execute the drawdown disbursement to the BusinessAccount (ENT-080) via CHAPS (same-day for amounts above BACS threshold) or BACS. SVC-005 waits for settlement confirmation before publishing EVT-037 (LoanDrawnDown). NOTE: SVC-009 is CAP-003 — this is a cross-capability call. It is permitted via direct API because payment instruction is an imperative command (not a domain event notification) and requires synchronous settlement confirmation for the drawdown to be finalised.
Dispatches customer notifications at each phase: application acknowledgement (PH-017), approval/decline letter (PH-019), drawdown confirmation (PH-021), covenant breach escalation (PH-022).
Authenticates RM and customer portal access throughout the journey. PSR 2017 SCA compliance for drawdown instructions.

design_decisions.decision: Business Lending origination is NOT promoted to a separate service. It remains as a retained sub-capability within SVC-005.
design_decisions.rationale: Business lending requires direct ledger access to BusinessCustomer (ENT-079) and BusinessAccount (ENT-080) for the drawdown disbursement and covenant monitoring against account activity. Extracting to a separate service would create a chatty intra-capability API dependency with no isolation benefit. The nCino lending origination workflow is embedded as a module within the SVC-005 commercial core implementation.

design_decisions.decision: The drawdown payment instruction to SVC-009 (CAP-003) is made via synchronous API, not async event.
design_decisions.rationale: A drawdown is an imperative financial command — SVC-005 must receive definitive settlement confirmation before updating LoanAccount.outstanding_balance and publishing EVT-037. Using an async event for the payment instruction would mean SVC-005 cannot reliably correlate the settlement outcome back to the specific drawdown request within acceptable SLA. The synchronous CHAPS instruction call is the industry-standard pattern for same-day commercial loan disbursement.

services.role_in_journey: Cross-capability credit risk scoring service. Subscribes to EVT-032 (CreditAssessmentRequested) from SVC-005, computes IRB PD/LGD/EAD/ECL parameters, creates ENT-018 (CreditAssessment), and publishes EVT-033 (CreditAssessmentCompleted) back to SVC-005. Also subscribes to EVT-037 (LoanDrawnDown), EVT-038 (LoanAccountOpened), and EVT-039 (CovenantBreachDetected) for ongoing portfolio capital and IFRS 9 calculations.

consumed_events.name: CreditAssessmentRequested
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-007 PH-018: Triggers automated IRB credit scoring workflow. SVC-012 retrieves financial data for the business_customer_id, runs PD/LGD/EAD models, calculates IFRS 9 ECL, creates ENT-018, and publishes EVT-033.

consumed_events.name: LoanDrawnDown
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-007 PH-021: Updates Basel 3.1 RWA register with new drawn exposure. Triggers IFRS 9 ECL provision booking at inception. Updates portfolio EAD for the commercial lending book.

consumed_events.name: LoanAccountOpened
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-007 PH-021: Adds loan to active credit portfolio register. Initiates periodic IFRS 9 ECL re-assessment schedule for the loan term.

consumed_events.name: CovenantBreachDetected
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-007 PH-022: Triggers IFRS 9 SICR assessment — evaluates whether the breach warrants stage migration from Stage 1 (12-month ECL) to Stage 2 (lifetime ECL) or Stage 3 (credit-impaired). Updates ECL provision. May publish EVT-033 (updated CreditAssessmentCompleted) if re-scoring is warranted.

design_decisions.decision: SVC-012 owns ENT-018 (CreditAssessment) exclusively. SVC-005 holds only the assessment_id reference received via EVT-033.
design_decisions.rationale: IRB model outputs are the CRO's accountability domain under SMCR. Storing them in SVC-005 would create a dual-ownership ambiguity that complicates PRA IRB model validation audits. The risk engine must independently control the lifecycle of credit assessment data.

services.role_in_journey: Executes the loan drawdown disbursement payment (PH-021) from the bank's funding account to the borrower's BusinessAccount (ENT-080). SVC-005 calls SVC-009 synchronously with a CHAPS or BACS payment instruction. SVC-009 is not involved in any other phase of JRN-007.

cross_service_interaction_summary.rationale: Async event is the ONLY permitted mechanism for CAP-002 to CAP-004 communication per the architectural principle. No synchronous API call permitted.
Async return event from SVC-012 back to SVC-005. SVC-005 subscribes to this event on the commercial.credit-assessments topic.
Payment instruction requires synchronous settlement confirmation. CHAPS same-day settlement for commercial loan drawdown cannot be modelled as a fire-and-forget event.
SVC-012 subscribes to drawdown events to update its portfolio capital and IFRS 9 ECL models. No synchronous call required — capital calculations are batch-amenable.
SVC-012 subscribes to covenant breach events for IFRS 9 SICR re-assessment. Async pattern appropriate as stage migration calculation is non-time-critical within the ECL reporting cycle.
